PHASE.NAME: RTK Discovery And Learning Parity
PHASE.GOAL: Bring RTK discover/learn concepts into Synapse as bounded, MyGRACE-compatible diagnostics instead of ungoverned heuristic code.

STEPS.step-1: Exposed bounded syn discover and syn learn diagnostics for routeable token-heavy commands and Synapse replacement suggestions without scanning private session history.
STEPS.step-2: Published discover/learn command and RTK discovery capability metadata for CLI, docs, and status consumers.
STEPS.step-3: Surfaced RTK adoption diagnostics in project status as advisory metadata without weakening existing MyGRACE gates.
